text:
Riley: Heads-up 10:00am visitor from Bellhop with 2 small crates and a rolled banner. They asked to drop at lobby and sign in. Any preferred staging? :truck: :frame_photo:
Sam: Receiving A usually works for banners. Crates might fit on low bench by window. Avoid the bookshelf area (books + water risk).
FrontDeskBot: Delivery logged: 2x crate (label: 'Bellhop') + 1x rolled banner. Location: Receiving A. Temp badge color: lime. Visitor checklist: ID scan, lime sticker, sign log, escort option.
Isha: I'll meet at concierge and escort. Can someone save the quiet corner armchair 9:55-10:20? Quick poll: :thumbsup: to hold it, :thumbsdown: if you need it.
Ben: :thumbsup: I'll move my laptop to the small table.
Sam: Facilities can help at 9:50 if crates are heavy.
Riley: Please add sticky: "Fragile - banner" on roll and "Do not stack" on crates. Also mark crates in log as fragile.
FrontDeskBot: Done 1: crates flagged fragile; delivery log updated with notes. Temp badge color set to lime. Facilities notified for 9:50.
Isha: Thanks team 49a I'll be at concierge by 9:55.
Riley: Awesome. If anything changes ping here.
_meta: short slack thread coordinating visitor dropoff (crates + banner), temp badging, fragile labels, facilities assistance, and reserving a seating spot
